name: horse-working-strict
prompt: Strict low-resolution 2D pixel game sprite art, like a 1990s arcade/browser mini game. Hard square pixels, nearest-neighbor look, chunky black outline, limited color palette, no antialiasing, no painterly lighting, no smooth digital illustration, no gradients, no glow, no 3D render, no watermark. The art should look like it was drawn at tiny sprite resolution and enlarged. Use a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background. The background must be one uniform color with no shadow, texture, floor, gradients, or light spill. Do not use #00ff00 inside the character. Keep each character fully separated from the background. Make exactly four equal animation frames in one horizontal row, no gutters, no labels, no text. The same character must keep the same size and same seat position in all frames; only tiny hand, ear, head, and mouth motion changes. Leave the top 22 percent of every cell empty so the sprite can sit in front of a CRT without covering the monitor screen. No computer monitor, no desk, no keyboard unless explicitly requested, no room background. Subject: cute brown chibi horse office worker, side three-quarter view facing left, sitting on a small blue stool, front hooves low as if typing on an invisible keyboard on a desk in front of it, focused but funny expression. Readable game silhouette, medium brown body, cream muzzle, small dark mane, compact body, not shiny, not realistic.
